<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex081012026-07-0802-57-54" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3811">mu tra</rs> yid kyi rnam shes rtog bcas kyi shes pa'i bzung bya yin zer ro || 
<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4243">'ban</rs> rnam shes tshogs myad kyi bzun bya yin zer yang dbus mtha'i ti ka rnam ces tshog <lb n="4b4"/> brgyad kyi rgyu'i cha la rgyu mtshan du bshad de ltar na kun gzhi sa bon gyi cha la rnam shes tshogs brgyad bskyed pa'i sa bon yod pas rgyu mtshan yin zer ¦ 
bsdu ba nas <expan>thams cad</expan> la rgyu mtshan gyi sgrar sbyar nas bshad de ming nyed shes pa'i bzhun byar byung pa la mi sgyu mtshan ces dgogs pa'o || </seg></TEI>
source: 3_081_01 mngon pa kun las btus pa'i rgyan ces bya.xml
